messages:
carol: spotted a small gap (~18k events) in eu-west aggregates for 2026-07-04T14:40-15:00. looks like a routing rule change silently bumped low-priority replays into standard lane.
deep: oh no, any deploys to the queue-router?
queue-bot: router-config: rule rollback at 2026-07-04T14:35 -> previous stable. change had transient effect for 6m.
sasha: that would explain it. proposal: we should gate ad-hoc priority rules with a short TTL + a backfill-tag whitelist. prevents accidental promotion.
matt: agree. operationally, short-term plan: run a scoped backfill for affected tenant_ids [E1,E4], dedupe=true, concurrency=6, tag=eu-west-gating-fix-20260704. route via priority-burst=8% for 1h. show a subtle banner on console for those tenants.
carol: safety checks: abort if consumer 429 > 3% or merge lag > 90s. also run postcheck comparing top-5 metrics delta <0.2%.
deep: I'll open two PRs: 1) router change -> default TTL=60m for ad-hoc priority rules and whitelist check, 2) console change -> small banner flag console.replay_flag.gating_fix_euwest.
sasha: doing a quick scope query now: `SELECT count(*) FROM telemetry.events WHERE region='eu-west' AND created_ts BETWEEN '2026-07-04 14:40:00' AND '2026-07-04 15:00:00' AND tag='replay_candidate';` -> ~18,412. good to be scoped.
queue-bot: scheduled backfill job id=job-20260704-0091 owner=matt tag=eu-west-gating-fix-20260704
matt: started job job-20260704-0091. shard progress: `shard=0 processed=512 deduped=2 errs=0`
carol: enable banner copy: "Temporary reprocessing in progress (ETA ~40m). Numbers may change." enable for E1/E4.
sasha: mid-run: 4/8 shards done, processed=9.4k, deduped=8. no 429 spikes.
matt: job completed processed=18412 deduped=29 errs=0. reconciliation shows diffs <0.15%. disabling priority-burst and removing temporary routing rule.
deep: PRs created and linked to this thread. good catch and quick run. I'll follow up with a short postmortem note for product.
carol: thanks team. leaving banner up for 30m then removing. action items: deep -> merge router TTL PR, sasha -> console flag cleanup, matt -> add job link to incident note.
queue-bot: incident-logger: draft created -> /incidents/2026-07-04-priority-gate-draft.md
